remarks: UNIQUE AND ONE OF A KIND APARTMENT. Come and enjoy the quiet and relaxing surroundings in Westport, Ct.. This furnished one bedroom apartment is ready for you to move right in and all utilities are included! More benefits include your own driveway and private entrance, laundry inside unit on main floor, central air, a beautiful backyard to enjoy nature and the list goes on. A large bay window and several skylights let in plenty of natural light into the apartment. There are also many large windows to keep the apartment bright. An open concept layout gives you a grand view of the kitchen, breakfast bar, dining area and living room. This country style living is situated close to shopping centers, to the beach and has easy access to I-95 or the Merritt Parkway.
